transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?

I guess… I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I used to make time for things—painting, hiking, choir, family on Sundays—and lately, even if I have a free hour, I just sit there. I can’t seem to care about any of it.
Have you noticed that you no longer take pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, like painting, hiking, or spending time with family?

Yes… that’s probably the main thing. I used to actually want to paint, or go hiking, or sing with the choir. Sundays with family mattered to me. Now, even if I have time, I mostly just sit there and… I don’t feel much interest in any of it.
Have you noticed feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes… most days. It’s like there’s this gray heaviness over everything. I can be at school with the students, or sitting at home with my husband, and I still feel… hollow. Like I’m close to crying, even if nothing has happened.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy levels or feel fatigued, even after resting?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I haven’t really been keeping track. Rest doesn’t always make me feel much better, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
Not really… I haven’t noticed anything clear. My appetite’s maybe about the same, and I don’t think my weight has changed much.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the gray heaviness and lack of interest in things?
Probably… about eight months. It kind of started building after I took over the STEM-Arts curriculum initiative. I didn’t notice it all at once, but… it’s been there since then.
Would you say you’ve been feeling a noticeable loss of energy or feel fatigued most days, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I get tired sometimes, but I don’t know if it’s most days or anything noticeable like that.
Would you say you feel depressed or down most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes… most days, I think. It’s like there’s this heavy gray film over everything. Even if I’m in the classroom or at home with my husband, I can still feel… hollow. Close to tears sometimes.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty about things more often lately?

Yeah… I guess so. When something goes wrong with the curriculum project, even something small, I start thinking I’m letting the students down. And then I think about my parents and what they gave up for me to have chances like this, and it feels like I’m wasting it.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating or making decisions lately, even about small things?
I don’t know… I haven’t really kept track. Maybe a little here and there, but I’m not sure it’s something I’ve noticed clearly.
Would you say that you’ve felt a clear loss of energy or felt fatigued nearly every day, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I’m… not really sure. I mean, I get tired, but I don’t know if it’s more than what’s normal. I haven’t paid close attention to it.
Would you say that you’ve felt a clear loss of energy or felt fatigued almost every day, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I’m not sure I’d say it’s almost every day. I get tired sometimes, but… I haven’t really noticed it clearly enough to say that.
Would you say that you’ve felt a noticeable lack of energy or felt tired on most days, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I’m not really sure. I mean, some days I feel worn out, but I don’t know if I’d call it most days or anything definite.
Would you say that you’ve felt a noticeable lack of energy or felt tired on most days, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I don’t really know how to measure that. I have days where I’m tired, but I can’t honestly say it’s most days or even when I haven’t done much. I just haven’t kept track.
Would you say that you’ve felt a noticeable lack of energy or felt tired on most days, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I feel like I’m repeating myself, but… I really don’t know. I get tired, sure, but I haven’t noticed it as a most-days thing.
Have you noticed any difficulty thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions lately?
I’m not sure. I mean, maybe I’ve been a bit scattered sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed a clear problem with thinking or decisions.
Would you say you’ve completely lost interest in all or almost all activities, including things you used to enjoy like painting, hiking, or spending time with family?

Yes… I think so. That’s actually part of why I came in. I used to make time for painting, hiking, choir, seeing family on Sundays… and now, even if I have the time, I just sit there. I don’t really care enough to start.
Would you say that your depressed mood has been present for most of the day, nearly every day, during the past eight months?
Yes… most days. It’s like there’s this heavy gray film over everything. Even when I’m in the classroom with students, or at home with my husband, I still feel kind of hollow… close to tears.
